visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video uses a vertical split-screen format. The top half features a young man with black hair and glasses wearing a beige hoodie, reacting to gameplay. The bottom half displays a mobile MOBA game (Arena of Valor) showing characters moving in a forest-like map. (2) The game displays character names like 'Leonardo' and 'Pikachu'. The man on top gestures with his hands and shifts his facial expressions from curiosity to amusement as he watches the screen. (3) Intense gameplay action occurs in the bottom frame with health bars depleting and characters clashing. The man's reaction intensifies into laughter, showing his teeth and squinting his eyes. (4) The scene transitions as the man brings a small red wooden fish (muyu) into the frame. He holds a mallet and hits the instrument rhythmically while his lips move in a chanting motion. (5) Social media icons and handles for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook are consistently displayed in the bottom corners of the frame throughout the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking with high energy and an excited tone, articulating names and commenting on screen events. The background features a steady, upbeat electronic BGM track. (2) A sudden burst of loud laughter occurs, accompanied by an in-game 'killed' sound effect. The vocal intensity remains high. (3) A new phase is triggered by a loud, rhythmic percussive clicking sound (wooden fish). The speaker's tone shifts to a mock-solemn, rhythmic chant. (4) The chant 'A-mi-tuo-fo' is repeated in a melodic, low-arousal pattern perfectly synchronized with the high-transient percussive taps until the audio ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain viewers by reacting to humorous or unexpected player names encountered in a MOBA game. The creator builds humor by combining gameplay commentary with a mock-religious ritual (using a wooden fish) to 'mourn' or 'pray' for the characters.
